Hi Marissa / Alex,

Thanks for the ping — happy to provide details. Below is a concise summary you can share with FintechCo. I’ve attached a redacted pen test summary (2025 external engagement) — full report is available under NDA only.

Redwood vulnerability & compliance summary:

- SOC 2: Type II opinion completed 2025; report available under NDA.
- Pen testing cadence: External third-party penetration tests annually (most recent: Dec 2025); internal quarterly red-team exercises and monthly automated vulnerability scanning (authenticated scans on prod-like environments).
- Scanning cadence: Daily internal SCA / dependency scans, weekly infrastructure vulnerability scans, monthly application scans, quarterly external scans.
- Remediation SLAs (target windows from detection):
  - Critical (P0/P1): 72 hours for triage and mitigation plan; aim to remediate within 7 days where possible.
  - High (P2): 14 days to remediation or implementation of compensating controls.
  - Medium (P3): 30 days.
  - Low: next scheduled sprint (tracked in backlog).
- Disclosure policy: Coordinated disclosure with a 30-day remediation/disclosure window; we coordinate with vendors/customers for public advisories.
- Vulnerability management process: Findings are triaged by Severity -> Owner assignment -> Ticket creation (Jira) -> ETA and tracking; monthly executive security review for outstanding high/critical items.
- Pen test sharing: We provide a redacted executive summary publicly; full technical reports require NDA and controlled distribution.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (redacted executive summary)

If FintechCo needs specific evidence or a SOC 2 report, we can kick off an NDA and share the materials. Marissa — happy to hop on a 30-minute call with Alex to walk through details if helpful.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
